name: Meh Chang
biography: Tingyi Chang, also known as Meh Chang, is a security researcher at DEVCORE. She focuses on binary program analysis and exploitation. She is a member of HITCON and 217 CTF team and has won the second place of DEF CON 25. Twitter: @mehqq_
